hook.en: A night light that switches on by itself when it gets dark needs only a battery, an LDR, a transistor, a resistor and an LED.
hook.bm: Lampu malam yang menyala sendiri apabila gelap hanya memerlukan bateri, LDR, transistor, perintang dan LED.

bigIdeas.en: Components have standard symbols so anyone can read a circuit diagram.
bigIdeas.bm: Komponen mempunyai simbol piawai supaya sesiapa sahaja boleh membaca gambar rajah litar.

bigIdeas.en: In series, current is the same everywhere; in parallel, each branch gets the full voltage.
bigIdeas.bm: Dalam litar bersiri, arus sama di semua tempat; dalam litar selari, setiap cabang menerima voltan penuh.

bigIdeas.en: Ohm's law V = IR links voltage, current and resistance; resistors protect LEDs.
bigIdeas.bm: Hukum Ohm V = IR menghubungkan voltan, arus dan rintangan; perintang melindungi LED.

definition.en: Light-emitting diode; lets current flow one way. Long leg = anode (+).
definition.bm: Diod pemancar cahaya; arus mengalir satu arah. Kaki panjang = anod (+).

definition.en: Limits current; value shown by colour bands.
definition.bm: Mengehadkan arus; nilai ditunjukkan oleh jalur warna.

definition.en: Light-dependent resistor: resistance falls as light increases.
definition.bm: Perintang peka cahaya: rintangan berkurang apabila cahaya bertambah.

definition.en: Having + and − sides that must be connected correctly.
definition.bm: Mempunyai bahagian + dan − yang mesti disambung dengan betul.

question.en: An LED needs 2 V and 20 mA. The battery is 9 V. What resistor is needed?
question.bm: LED memerlukan 2 V dan 20 mA. Bateri ialah 9 V. Berapakah perintang yang diperlukan?

steps.en: R = V ÷ I = 7 ÷ 0.02 = 350 Ω (use the next standard value up, e.g. 390 Ω).
steps.bm: R = V ÷ I = 7 ÷ 0.02 = 350 Ω (gunakan nilai piawai seterusnya, cth. 390 Ω).

prompt.en: The calculated resistor is 350 Ω, but only 330 Ω and 390 Ω are available. Which should you choose and why?

explanation.en: Choose the next value UP to stay within the LED's current limit.
explanation.bm: Pilih nilai seterusnya yang LEBIH TINGGI supaya kekal dalam had arus LED.

options.bm: 390 Ω — arus yang sedikit kurang memastikan LED selamat

options.en: 330 Ω — more current is always better

options.en: Either, it makes no difference at all

options.en: Current = 7 V ÷ 100 Ω = 70 mA, far more than 20 mA
